verified_facts.text: The hotel faces Madrid's Neptune Fountain and has been a city landmark since 1912.
verified_facts.excerpt: Facing Madrid's iconic Neptune Fountain, The Palace Hotel, Madrid, a Luxury Collection Hotel, has been one of the city's most celebrated landmarks since 1912.

verified_facts.text: The hotel stands within Madrid's UNESCO-listed Landscape of Light district.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel stands within Madrid’s UNESCO accredited Landscape of Light district

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the Golden Triangle of Art, beside the Prado, Reina Sofia and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the heart of the Golden Triangle of Art, The Palace sits side-by-side with the city’s iconic museums, Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen-Bornemisza.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is next to the Barrio de las Letras, the literary quarter linked to Cervantes and Lope de Vega.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Palace sits adjacent to the vibrant Bohemian area, Barrio de las Letras.

verified_facts.text: The wrought iron and glass dome was designed by Eduardo Ferres i Puig in 1912 and made by the Maumejean Brothers glass studio.
verified_facts.excerpt: its wrought iron and glass dome, designed by Eduardo Ferrés i Puig in 1912, and executed by the master glassmakers at the Mauméjean Brothers studio

verified_facts.text: Barcelona designer Lazaro Rosa-Violan created the interiors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ruiz Larrea Arquitectura with Lázaro Rosa-Violán entrusted with the interiors

verified_facts.text: The Palace was Spain's first hotel to have private toilets in every room.
verified_facts.excerpt: it was Spain’s first hotel (and the second in the world) to have private toilets in every room

verified_facts.text: Federico Garcia Lorca, Salvador Dali and Luis Bunuel were among those who drank at the Palace's bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Poet Federico García Lorca, painter Salvador Dalí, and film director Luis Buñuel were among the luminaries to raise a drink at the Palace.

verified_facts.text: Past guests include Ava Gardner, Orson Welles and The Three Tenors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Home to the aristocracy, as well as Spanish and Hollywood royalty, such as The Three Tenors, Ava Gardner, Sofia Loren, Orson Welles and others

verified_facts.text: The one-bedroom Royal Suite overlooks the Neptuno Fountain and has a grand dining room, a library with bar and a chef's kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: The expansive one-bedroom suite, overlooking Neptuno Fountain, has been fashioned to incorporate grand dining room, library with bar and chef’s kitchen.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have city views that include the Neptuno Fountain, Cortes Square and the Congress of Deputies.
verified_facts.excerpt: benefit from an array of spectacular city aspects, including views across Neptuno Fountain, Cortes Square and Congress of Deputies

verified_facts.text: The Palace Suite keeps an original fireplace, with bespoke wallpaper inspired by Surrealism.
verified_facts.excerpt: Historical context remains with the original fireplace as a stylish centerpiece, while bespoke wallpaper draws on the destination’s affinity with the Surrealist movement.

verified_facts.text: The Cervantes Suite honors Miguel de Cervantes, with handcrafted tapestry inspired by the Retiro park.
verified_facts.excerpt: An homage to renowned Spanish writer, Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra, this suite is furnished with handcrafted tapestry that draws inspiration from neighboring Parque del Retiro.

verified_facts.text: Room wallpapers are inspired by Retiro Park and shower mosaics evoke a bird's-eye view of the Royal Botanic Gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: All the wallpapers are inspired by the landscapes of the nearby Retiro Park, just as the mosaics in the showers evoke a bird's-eye view of the Royal Botanic Gardens.

verified_facts.text: Bathroom amenities are Le Chemin by Byredo, made exclusively for Luxury Collection hotels.
verified_facts.excerpt: the bathroom amenities are from Le Chemin by Byredo, created exclusively for Marriott’s Luxury Collection hotels

verified_facts.text: La Cupula restaurant sits beneath a stained-glass dome and serves from breakfast onward.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Cúpula is a cosmopolitan Madrid restaurant beneath an imposing stained-glass dome, where guests gather from breakfast onward

verified_facts.text: Ernest Hemingway paid literary tribute to the dry martini of the hotel's 27 Club bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Immortalized by Ernest Hemingway’s literary tribute of the club’s dry martini

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has a sauna and a terrace-solarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sauna and terrace-solarium for relaxation and recovery.

verified_facts.text: Massages, facials and body treatments are offered in a private treatment cabin.
verified_facts.excerpt: Personalized massages, facial and body treatments.

verified_facts.text: The gym is on the top floor of the building.
verified_facts.excerpt: is located on the top floor, almost touching the Madrid sky

verified_facts.text: A package with the Thyssen-Bornemisza museum includes a guided tour of the collection before opening.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests will receive a morning guided tour, where the collection’s treasures can be enjoyed pre-opening.

verified_facts.text: Parque del Retiro is within walking distance of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Within walking distance of The Palace, Parque del Retiro spans over 350-acres of natural landscape

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers on-property personal shopping.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alongside on-property personal shopping

verified_facts.text: Connecting rooms are available for families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Connecting rooms ideal for families.

verified_facts.text: Dogs and cats up to 20 kg are accepted, with an added fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: We accept domesticated pets: dogs and cats maximum 20 kg. Added fee will apply.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast at La Cupula is available for a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: breakfast is available onsite at La Cúpula Restaurant & Bar for a fee

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Guest rooms have a courtyard view.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1 King, Courtyard view

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not have electric vehicle charging stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: does not have electric vehicle charging stations
